# Sushma Tripathi

> Professional Insurance Advisor specializing in life, health, motor, and business insurance across India.

## Who is Sushma Tripathi?

Sushma Tripathi is a professional insurance advisor based in India. She helps individuals, families, and businesses choose the right insurance coverage through personalized consultations. She offers expert guidance across all major insurance categories and provides free consultations to prospective clients.

## Services Offered

- **Life Insurance** — Term, endowment, and whole life plans for individuals and families
- **Health Insurance** — Individual, family floater, and senior citizen health plans
- **Motor Insurance** — Car, bike, and commercial vehicle insurance
- **Home Insurance** — Property and household content protection
- **Office / Business Insurance** — Commercial property, liability, and business continuity
- **Employee Insurance** — Group health and life cover for organizations
- **Travel Insurance** — Domestic and international travel coverage

## Why Choose Sushma Tripathi?

- Personalized advice tailored to individual needs and budgets
- Expert knowledge across all insurance categories
- Trusted by individuals, families, and businesses across India
- Free consultation — no obligation
